subject: Trace sampling offset proposal & bridge credit inquiry
body:
From: Elena Soto <elena@veloxai.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 14 Nov 2026 09:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Trace sampling & retention question

Hi Marcus,

Thanks for the quick demo yesterday — VeloxAI is excited about the latency improvements and the new dashboard tiles for service-level traces. Before we sign, procurement asked us to clarify the long-term cost implications of the tracing + retention add-on. Specifically: can you explain how sampled trace storage would be billed vs. full retention, and whether Redwood offers any credit/offset if we commit to a yearly contracted ingestion?

Two constraints from our side:
- We want a seatless observability experience (no per-seat fees).
- We expect ~1.8B trace events/month initially with heavy spike days during quarterly releases.

Can you share a proposal that shows a) sample-rate pricing, b) how a retention commitment could be exchanged for credits, and c) whether advanced dashboard tiles are included or separate? Also copy procurement (procurement@veloxai.com) when you reply so they can see the numbers.

Best,
Elena
ELENA SOTO
Head of Infrastructure, VeloxAI

---

From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
To: Elena Soto <elena@veloxai.com>
Cc: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Trace sampling & retention question

Elena — thanks for the thoughtful note and the LSAT-sized data point (1.8B/month is helpful). I put together a compact proposal and attached a calculator that models sample-rate vs full retention with a couple of bridge-credit options. High level:

1) Pricing model (short):
- Ingestion & indexing: per-million events; sampling rate reduces effective ingestion linearly.
- Retention storage: priced per GB-month for full retention; sampled retention priced at 55% of full per-unit cost (reflects lower index density and compute).
- Dashboards: advanced dashboard tiles (alerting, waterfall trace views) are a separate add-on SKU but bundled on annuals at a 20% discount.

2) Bridge credit proposal (new / differentiated):
- If VeloxAI commits to a 12-month retention+ingest ARR (tiered commit based on expected monthly ingestion), Redwood will apply a bridge credit that offsets up to 6 months of retention costs for the first quarter after onboarding. The credit phases down after month 6 (50% months 7-9, 25% months 10-12).
- Purpose: smooth the migration economics for customers switching from raw full-retention to a sampling-first strategy.

3) Sampling offset mechanics:
- We model sampling as reducing ingest by the sample ratio; retained artifacts (KV cache of traces used for waterfall reconstruction) carry a smaller per-event cost.
- The attached spreadsheet shows scenarios where 5% sampling vs 25% sampling yields a 2.8x delta in monthly bill (ingest + retention + dashboard reads).

Next steps I propose:
- I’ll send a versioned PDF proposal for procurement with explicit line items (attached draft).
- If procurement accepts the bridge credit framework, we can convert to a signed SOW + DocuSign for the commitment and credit schedule.

I’m looping Priya (sales ops) on cc to ensure the numbers can be surfaced in the HubSpot deal and to generate a formal exhibit.

Regards,
Marcus Lin
Account Executive — Redwood Inference

Attachment: redwood_trace_credit_calculator.xlsx (spreadsheet)

Two quick asks so we can move to legal: 1) can you provide the exact exhibit language that documents the bridge credit schedule (we need to confirm how credits apply if actual ingest varies from committed ingestion), and 2) are advanced dashboard tiles included in the ARR commitment calculation or excluded?

We prefer credits to be invoice line-item adjustments rather than separate one-off refunds. Also include an example invoice for Q1 with and without the bridge credit.

Thanks,
Procurement Team — VeloxAI

From: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Nov 2026 13:02:00 -0800
Subject: Internal: draft exhibit and invoice examples

Marcus — drafting language below for the exhibit and an example invoice table. Sending for your sign-off before I drop into the HubSpot attachment.

Suggested exhibit wording (draft):
"Bridge Credit Exhibit — Trace Retention and Sampling
Customer commits to an annual ingestion & retention ARR (Committed Ingest). In exchange Redwood will provide a Bridge Credit against retention storage charges as follows: 100% credit on retention charges for months 1-3 up to the committed monthly retention quantity; 50% credit on retention charges for months 4-6 up to the committed monthly retention quantity; 25% credit on retention charges for months 7-9. Bridge Credits are applied as invoice line-item adjustments and are conditional on Customer maintaining the committed ingest profile. If actual ingest exceeds committed ingest, excess is billed at the standard ingest/retention rates. If actual ingest is less than 60% of committed ingest for a rolling 60-day period, Redwood reserves the right to re-evaluate credit eligibility. Credits expire 12 months after issuance.

Invoice example (Q1 onboarding) — simplified:
- Ingest charges (actual): $24,000
- Retention charges (pre-credit): $18,000
- Bridge credit applied (months 1-3 cap): -$18,000
- Dashboards add-on (annual amortized): $3,600
- Net due: $9,600

Notes: the invoice example assumes VeloxAI qualifies for the full 3-month retention credit based on committed ingest. We’ll provide a second example showing partial credit if commit/actual diverge.

I attached a cleaned PDF draft proposal (velox_proposal_v2.pdf) with these items. Once Marcus confirms, I’ll post the exhibit into HubSpot and push a DocuSign envelope with the SOW + exhibit.

-Jordan
Jordan Blake
Sales Strategy — Redwood Inference

Attachment: velox_proposal_v2.pdf (PDF)
